operation.description:
Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. Legacy compatibility endpoint for listing purchase orders.

This endpoint does **not** return a JSON collection. It responds with an HTTP **302** redirect whose `Location` header points to the v2 entity listing for purchase orders (`/v2/owner/entity/purchase_order-13/list`). To retrieve the purchase-order collection — with pagination, search and filtering — call the v2 entity listing endpoint for the `purchase_order` entity. Use `GET /purchase_orders/{id}` to fetch a single purchase order as JSON.

302.description: The legacy list endpoint responds with an HTTP 302 redirect to the v2 entity listing for purchase orders. No JSON collection is returned by this endpoint itself.

Location.description: The v2 entity listing URL for purchase orders that the request is redirected to.

401.description: Returned when the access token is missing or invalid.
